data: What is the R-squared value for the distribution function of node degrees for "Moby-Dick; or, The Whale"?

The R-squared value for the distribution function of node degrees for "Moby-Dick; or, The Whale" can be found in the caption of the figure. It is stated that the R-squared value is 0.9593. Therefore, the R-squared value is 0.9593.
